PR #35 verified nonowner tenant-bound PostgreSQL rejection-only role on actual two PG logins and Redis stream, write-before-XACK and privilege-loss PEL recovery (21 hosted service jobs at 797eb708). Existing synthetic job publish/claim/complete still uses privileged CI pool; live identity migration, signed publisher and production worker supervision/permissions remain unverified.

PR #36 22-job real PG16/Redis7 CI verified tenant-bound full synthetic job outbox publish, claim, atomic actor/account policy finalization and expiry with restricted authenticated login, SQL privilege revocation/Redis PEL recovery and cross-tenant denial on aa137693. Only CI-injected worker adapter; default standalone still privileged, publisher provenance and production role/key provisioning, live identity/provider permissions, DLQ/multiinstance/off-host restore and auth cutover not implemented.

PR #37 tested CI-only HMAC signed tenant/job/outbox wakeups with PG-bound Redis stream ID and rotation, anti-forgery/tamper/replay/quarantine checks across 23 real PG16/Redis7 hosted jobs at 4b177f1b. No independent production KMS/key rotation/Redis broker identities, full operator DLQ or provider permissions, offsite audit/recovery and real SQLite-to-PostgreSQL authentication cutover.

tasks.title: Implement authentication, tenant isolation, policy enforcement, and audit
tasks.description: Enforce tenant scope and operation policy in API and worker before real credentials or provider operations.
acceptance_criteria: Unauthenticated access denied
Cross-tenant read/write/job denial tested
Policy rechecked in worker
Audit is redacted and queryable
Session and MFA/recovery design documented
blockers: PostgreSQL 009 hosted CI-only atomic redacted login, pending MFA, recovery upgrade and logout audit migration succeeded with real non-owner role and previous unlogged functions denied. Tested 75 project unit tests, nine PostgreSQL/Redis/Compose service jobs and Chromium at functional SHA; tenant Node-compatible SHA chain and login/MFA/logout rollback fault injection verified. Standard SQLite/scrypt HTTP remains unchanged; unknown/wrong-password attempts are rate-limited but not tenant-audited. Still open: production credential verification/migration without plaintext export, complete auth-failure audit and MFA/TOTP/passkeys key custody, production TLS cookie/CSRF and trusted write roles, SQLite v7 jobs/audit/secrets migration, reversible cutover, off-host backup/recovery and scoped live provider consent.

PR #23 read-only legacy SQLite scrypt format tests passed GitHub CI on functional SHA 1ac44ad8; verifier remains unused by ordinary HTTP. Full migration, nonowner PG shadow store, key custody and production cutover remain unimplemented.

CI-only private PostgreSQL shadow fixture schema/force-RLS/non-owner-denial passed 10-job hosted service integration at f41f78c5; only fake placeholders are accepted. Real verifier custody, credential writer, source reauthentication/epoch fencing, auth audit, full runtime migration and production cutover are unimplemented.

CI-only SQLite source password reauthentication to separately salted PG synthetic verifier passed 11-job hosted PG16/Redis/Compose, PR CI and Chromium at 91d00a8. Shadow never authorizes login. Source epoch is a CI sidecar without real password/disable/MFA mutation hooks; distributed atomicity, revocation propagation, production KDF, authentication audit, MFA/key custody, full SQLite jobs/secrets migration and rollback remain blocked.

PR #26 synthetic-only source credential-epoch SQLite outbox and PG private revoke-only fences passed full 12-job hosted service integration plus CI/Chromium at 50ab3c6. Tested source+event atomicity, password reset/disable/MFA/role changes, PG fault rollback, source file reopen, pending-event replay, anti-regression and source-tenant mismatch. NOT integrated into normal login/mutation routes or real MFA key custody; no source-event provenance attestation, distributed atomicity, off-host restore or production authority gate.

PR #27 CI-only signed SQLite event provenance and HMAC-pseudonymous login-failure records passed 13 hosted PG16/Redis/Compose jobs, standard CI, Chromium on 01955da6. Tampering, wrong signing key, old-key rotation/replay, DB audit failure and unknown/wrong-password response parity tested. NOT runtime HTTP-wired or proof of independent source event completeness/authorization, distributed rate-limit, external key custody or production migration.

PR #28 CI-only synthetic actor fresh password/RBAC and separate PG source witness passed hosted 14-job integration + CI/Chromium at 70a6de2b. Tests detect deleted previously witnessed events, source epoch rollback, actor-HMAC tamper and restricted PG role denials. Still no atomic source-to-witness commit, WORM/external trust, real actor MFA/API mutation, independent key custody, off-host restore or production cutover.

PR #29 disposable detached signed source-witness checkpoint and CI-only fail-closed source/PG epoch consistency passed hosted 15-job service integration on 73a06983; detected stale signed checkpoint, missing PG witness, deleted source event, pending journal, lost PG epoch fence, stale draft and SQLite reopen. The separate auditor file/key are NOT off-host independent WORM; no operational key custody, source/PG atomicity, real MFA/HTTP or production login authority.

PR #30 CI-only cross-runner Ed25519 signed synthetic source epoch/witness metadata archive and atomic fresh-SQLite metadata restore passed 17 service-workflow jobs + standard CI + Chromium at b9edaa8d. Different GitHub jobs but shared admin trust, no independent WORM/KMS, no verified real source signing key, full encrypted off-host database/secret/job/MFA restore or production auth cutover.

tasks.title: AI plan integrity and automatic PR task-ledger governance
tasks.description: Reconcile canonical AI plan, task status timestamps, documentation and CI warnings; ensure each PR description contains a full up-to-date task table sourced from its head backlog and safely refreshed on PR lifecycle updates.
assumptions: Trusted-base pull_request_target workflow must never execute pull-request code
GitHub Actions token requires pull-requests:write for PR body patches; organization policy may prevent this
acceptance_criteria: Each newly opened/reopened/updated PR has an idempotent canonical status/evidence table in its description, including all open PRs on a main backlog change
CI rejects verified_at on nonverified tasks, task dependency cycles, incomplete blocker metadata, and backlog/summary drift
Human-authored PR body text remains intact; untrusted PR code is never executed in write-enabled workflow
Browser and service/product tasks retain honest verification level; external-provider blockers are never silently closed
Auto-update is proven against an actual open PR and exact runner output is recorded before marking verified
